title: Tame the long word
summary: A long unbroken string blows the layout out on a phone. Contain it.
brief: At 375px the long identifier in the text pushes past the right edge of .media.
Make everything fit inside .media at 375px, while the thumbnail stays 80px wide next to the text.
hints: Set the preview to 375px. Select .media and look at the overflow note in the Layout tab.
Flex items will not shrink below their min-content width, and an unbroken word is very wide min-content.
Allow the word to break with overflow-wrap: anywhere on .body (and min-width: 0 lets the item shrink).
solutionNotes: A flex item's default min-width: auto is its min-content width, here the whole unbroken identifier. overflow-wrap: anywhere lets the word break (and shrinks its min-content); min-width: 0 is the general fix that lets the item shrink at all.
